questions.q: Felino Palafox Jr. is a globally recognized expert in which field that extends beyond the design of individual buildings?
o: Renaissance Art History
Structural Steel Fabrication
Interior Yacht Design
Urban and Environmental Planning
questions.n: Palafox is a pioneer in master-planning entire cities and regions with a focus on sustainability and resilience.

questions.q: Before founding his own firm, Palafox worked on the master plan of which major international city in the Middle East, known for its rapid modern development?
o: Dubai
London
Paris
Rome
questions.n: Palafox played a significant role in the early master planning of Dubai, helping shape it into a global hub.

questions.q: Palafox often advocates for 'Walkability' and 'Bikeability' in cities. What is the primary environmental goal of these features?
o: To reduce carbon emissions and traffic congestion
To ensure that everyone has to exercise daily
To increase the sales of sports equipment
To make streets look more like historical European alleys
questions.n: By designing cities for people rather than just cars, he aims to create more sustainable and breathable urban environments.

questions.q: Which of these major Philippine retail developments features a master plan by Palafox Associates, noted for its expansive layout and integration of open spaces?
o: Gota de Leche
The Metropolitan Theater
Tutuban Center
SM Mall of Asia (Master Plan)
questions.n: Palafox Associates was involved in the master planning of the massive MOA complex, one of the largest in the world.

questions.q: True or False: Felino Palafox Jr. is a fellow of the American Institute of Architects (AIA) and has been recognized for his contributions to global architecture.
o: True
False
questions.n: He is one of the few Filipino architects with such high-level international standing and recognition.

questions.q: Felino Palafox Jr. often advocates for 'Vertical Urbanism.' What is the primary purpose of this concept in a rapidly growing city like Manila?
o: To ensure every citizen has a view of the mountains
To make the city look more like a science fiction movie
To increase the cost of real estate by building taller
To reduce urban sprawl and maximize land efficiency
questions.n: Building upward allows for higher density in smaller footprints, preserving surrounding green spaces or agricultural land.

questions.q: Which of these design philosophies, championed by Palafox, focuses on creating self-contained communities where everything is within a short walk?
o: Industrial Minimalism
The 15-Minute City (New Urbanism)
International Style
Brutalism
questions.n: This concept ensures that work, residence, and leisure are all accessible without needing a car, promoting health and reducing pollution.

questions.q: In his advocacy for 'Disaster Resilient' cities, Palafox emphasizes which feature to mitigate the effects of heavy flooding in the Philippines?
o: Building massive glass domes over entire cities
Integrating open spaces as 'absorption zones' and detention ponds
Paving over every inch of soil with waterproof cement
Moving all major cities to the peaks of mountains
questions.n: Soft landscapes and ponds allow floodwaters to be managed naturally rather than letting them overwhelm concrete streets.

questions.q: Palafox was involved in the development of 'Clark Freeport Zone.' What was a major planning goal for this area compared to Metro Manila?
o: To create a 'Smart and Green' city with better infrastructure and logistics
To replicate the exact density and traffic of Manila
To preserve it as a purely agricultural forest with no buildings
To build only residential homes with no commercial zones
questions.n: The plan focused on organized zoning, green corridors, and high-tech infrastructure to attract global investment.

questions.q: One of Palafox's core tenets is 'Transit-Oriented Development' (TOD). What is the central feature of a TOD?
o: Building a shopping mall in the middle of a desert
Placing high-density housing and offices within walking distance of public transit hubs
Building more highways for private luxury cars
Creating giant parking lots as the main feature of a city
questions.n: By concentrating development near trains or buses, the need for private car ownership is significantly reduced.

questions.q: True or False: Palafox Associates was the first Filipino architectural firm to be ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified for its quality and environmental management systems.
o: True
False
questions.n: This certification reflects the firm's commitment to international standards of professional practice and environmental care.

questions.q: Palafox often cites the 'Garden City' concept. Who was the original pioneer of this concept that Palafox adapts for modern use?
o: Le Corbusier
Frank Lloyd Wright
Ebenezer Howard
Oscar Niemeyer
questions.n: Howard's 1898 concept of self-contained communities surrounded by 'greenbelts' is a major inspiration for sustainable planning today.

questions.q: In planning for 'Resilience,' Palafox suggests that Manila should utilize its waterfronts. What is his specific suggestion for the Pasig River?
o: To pave it over to create a new 10-lane highway
To use it as the primary disposal site for industrial waste
To freeze the river solid to create a winter theme park
To transform it into a vibrant 'blue-green' corridor for transport and tourism
questions.n: Utilizing the river for ferries and riverfront parks improves urban mobility and creates public leisure spaces.

questions.q: Which of these is a hallmark of a 'Palafox' master plan for a large-scale township?
o: Uniform buildings that all look exactly the same
The integration of multi-modal transport and lush greenery
Gated walls that prevent all pedestrians from entering
Removal of all natural hills and water bodies to flatten the land
questions.n: His plans typically balance built structures with heavy landscaping and diverse transportation options like walking and biking.

questions.q: Palafox has worked on projects in over 40 countries. What does he often say is the greatest 'export' of Filipino architects?
o: Specific types of Philippine volcanic ash for cement
The secret to building nipa huts in the desert
Cheap building materials
Global Filipino talent and cultural adaptability
questions.n: Filipino architects are recognized worldwide for their skill, hard work, and ability to design for various climates and cultures.
